propositions: The (inbound, probe) dispatch chain has no live producer because differ._compute_mutations_emit_absent_partner_probes only fires when local_state entries carry jira_key, but run_differs passes a fetched Jira snapshot whose entries never carry jira_key

Deletion-vs-aged-out discrimination is already implemented elsewhere: outbound_differ._safe_get_issue and binding_walk.py:187-196 both perform bounded direct GETs on confirmed 404s, verified live on DC

When a binding is retired after 3 consecutive confirmed-404 note_absent calls, _retire pops it from both bindings and reverse, making the local ticket unbound and triggering an outbound CREATE for a fresh Jira issue, resurrecting deliberately-deleted work

The resurrection implementation (inbound_delete producer, _apply_inbound_delete, create_after_hard_delete, _build_hard_delete_recreate) must be removed per operator ruling that deleted Jira issues should never be resurrected
A tombstone guard using BindingStore.is_retired_local must suppress outbound CREATE for local tickets whose bindings were retired on confirmed 404, while never-bound tickets still create normally
